tooltip.essentialcraft5.torn_survey_map..en: Found in chests in the towers of ruined towns and in old catacombs. Three of them and a Ley Crystal make a Hoanna Survey Map.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.torn_survey_map..zh: 城镇废墟的塔顶、古代墓穴的箱子里能翻到。三张加一颗地脉结晶，能拼成一张海纳尔勘测图。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.hoanna_survey_ma.en: Right-click in Hoanna to mark the nearest site. Sneak and right-click to change what it looks for.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.hoanna_survey_ma.zh: 在海纳尔里右键，标出最近的一处。潜行右键换要找的东西。

message.essentialcraft5.hoanna_survey_ma.en: This map only finds its way in Hoanna
message.essentialcraft5.hoanna_survey_ma.zh: 这张图只在海纳尔里认得路

message.essentialcraft5.hoanna_survey_ma.en: Still working out the last one, give it a moment
Nothing here that the map knows how to find
message.essentialcraft5.hoanna_survey_ma.zh: 这里没有勘测图找得到的东西

message.essentialcraft5.hoanna_survey_ma.en: You've reached the marked spot. Right-click to find the next one.
message.essentialcraft5.hoanna_survey_ma.zh: 你到了图上标的地方。再右键找下一处。

message.essentialcraft5.ruin_milestone.h.en: Ruins of a town lie about %2$s blocks to the %1$s
message.essentialcraft5.ruin_milestone.h.zh: %s方约 %s 格外有一座城的残骸

message.essentialcraft5.ruin_milestone.n.en: The milestone points to no town within %s blocks
message.essentialcraft5.ruin_milestone.n.zh: %s 格内看不出哪里有城的残骸

message.essentialcraft5.ruin_milestone.n.en: The marks on this milestone only make sense in Hoanna
message.essentialcraft5.ruin_milestone.n.zh: 这块里程碑上的刻痕只在海纳尔里对得上方向

tooltip.essentialcraft5.abyssal_salt.des.en: Eat it to clear %s%% of your Hoanna radiation dose (at least %s, at most %s). Works anywhere, and leaves you hungry for a while.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.abyssal_salt.des.zh: 吃下去清掉当前海纳尔辐射剂量的 %s%%（至少 %s、至多 %s），在哪儿吃都管用，吃完会饿一阵。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.abyssal_salt.coo.en: You can eat another after %s minutes.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.abyssal_salt.coo.zh: 吃完 %s 分钟以后才能再吃。

message.essentialcraft5.abyssal_salt.coo.en: You can't stomach more salt yet: %s seconds to go
